sourceType.title: Source Type
sourceType.description: Selects how the source response and mapping paths are interpreted. JSON is the only implemented source type. Additional source formats can be added as isolated handlers later.

source.title: Source URL
source.description: Complete HTTP or HTTPS URL for the single weather data source. Query credentials may be included in this URL. The plugin redacts likely secret query values from its own logs.

interval.title: Update Interval
interval.description: Minutes between source refreshes. The default is 5 minutes. A new request never starts while the previous refresh is still running.

name.title: Accessory Name
name.description: Optional display name for the single weather accessory. Changing this name does not change the internally generated accessory identity.

mappings.title: Weather Mappings
mappings.description: Maps named weather measurements to values in the selected source format. Every entry contains exactly a user-visible name, one supported unit, and its source path. The same unit can be used repeatedly under different names. No accessory is created until at least one valid mapping exists.

name.title: Measurement Name
name.description: User-chosen label shown for this measurement, such as Temperature, Dew Point, or Wind at 80 m. The plugin does not translate this name. Use a distinct name when the same unit is mapped more than once.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Canonical source unit or explicit wind-direction conversion that selects the plugin's HomeKit characteristic metadata, normalization, and neutral fallback. Use 1 for dimensionless, blank, or undefined Open-Meteo units; ms covers generationtime_ms; s covers both s and seconds; WMO covers Open-Meteo wmo code values. Wind directions support ° directly, compass16 text directly, compass16->° conversion, and °->compass16 conversion.

path.title: Source Path
path.description: Path to the source value. JSON sources support dot and array notation such as observations[0].metric.temp and JSON Pointer notation such as /observations/0/metric/temp.
